query.name: com.archboard.tidal_ptc.students.enrollment
query.sql: select cc.dcid as section_dcid, s.dcid as student_dcid from students s join cc on cc.studentid = s.id where cc.termid in ( select id from terms where terms.schoolid = cc.schoolid and firstday <= trunc(sysdate) and lastday >= trunc(sysdate) ) and s.dcid in (:dcid) order by s.dcid

query.name: com.archboard.tidal_ptc.guardian.contactid
query.description: Gets the contact id of the guardian
query.sql: select personid as contact_id from guardianpersonassoc where guardianid = :guardianid

query.name: com.archboard.tidal_ptc.user.get
query.description: Gets the data for a user/staff.
query.sql: select first_name, last_name, email_addr as email, homeroom from users where dcid = :dcid

query.name: com.archboard.tidal_ptc.user.search
query.description: Searches for a user by name or email.
query.sql: select dcid, first_name || ' ' || last_name as name, first_name, last_name, email_addr as email, homeroom from users where upper(first_name || ' ' || last_name) like upper('%' || :search || '%') or upper(email_addr) like upper('%' || :search || '%')
